entities.summary: María Álvarez de Guillén (1889–1980), pen name Amari Zalvera, was a Salvadoran businesswoman, writer and women's rights activist. She was one of the first Salvadoran women to publish a novel and was one of the first delegates to serve on the Inter-American Commission of Women.

entities.summary: María Álvarez de Guillén (1889–1980), pen name Amari Zalvera, was a Salvadoran businesswoman, writer and women's rights activist. She was one of the first Salvadoran women to publish a novel and was one of the first delegates to serve on the Inter-American Commission of Women.
